findings_qualitative.value: Tentative identification of a handful of emission lines of c-CD2CH2O toward IRAS 16293-2422 B in the ALMA PILS survey.

evidence.quote: Using PILS data of IRAS 16293$-$2422, we tentatively identified a handful of lines of this isotopolog toward source B: with a column density derived on basis of these lines, no other non-detected features are predicted.

findings_qualitative.value: Watson's A reduction in the oblate representation III^l yields a fit of essentially identical quality to the S reduction for c-CD2CH2O, in contrast to the main isotopolog c-C2H4O.

evidence.quote: It is noteworthy that the A reduction in the III$^l$ representation yields a fit of essentially identical quality with the same number of spectroscopic parameters.

claims.hypothesis: The doubly deuterated oxirane isotopomer c-CD2CH2O can be rotational-spectroscopically characterized and detected in the ALMA PILS data toward IRAS 16293-2422 B.
claims.experiment: Synthesized c-CD2CH2O, measured its rotational spectrum from 120 to 1094 GHz, determined spectroscopic parameters up to eighth order, and fitted LTE synthetic spectra to the ALMA Band 7 PILS observations.
claims.result: 1289 transition frequencies were fitted to ~12 kHz rms; in the PILS data, a handful of the 16 brightest predicted lines match observed features >20 mJy beam^-1 km s^-1, implying N = 3.3 x 10^14 cm^-2 with no missing predicted lines.
claims.finding: c-CD2CH2O is tentatively detected toward IRAS 16293-2422 B.

evidence.quote: the calculated rest frequencies were used to identify $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O tentatively in the interstellar medium in the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey (PILS) of the Class 0 protostellar system IRAS 16293$-$2422.
Still, our astronomical results on $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O should be viewed with some caution as the number of identified lines is on the low side to claim a definitive detection.

claims.hypothesis: Doubly deuterated oxirane exhibits a higher degree of deuteration per H atom than singly deuterated oxirane, consistent with other complex organic molecules in IRAS 16293-2422 B.
claims.experiment: Compared the derived c-CD2CH2O column density (3.3 x 10^14 cm^-2) with previously determined column densities of c-C2H3DO (8.9 x 10^14 cm^-2) and c-C2H4O (6.1 x 10^15 cm^-2) at T_rot = 125 K.
claims.result: The c-CD2CH2O / c-C2H4O ratio is ~0.054, translating to a D/H ratio of ~16% per H atom, which is 4.5 times higher than the ~0.036 per H atom found for c-C2H3DO.
claims.finding: The deuteration enhancement of c-CD2CH2O relative to c-C2H3DO matches the 15-25% D/H range of other doubly deuterated COMs toward IRAS 16293-2422 B, pointing to a common low-temperature grain-surface formation mechanism.

evidence.quote: Considering that there are statistically two ways to form $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O, but only one for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O, this gives a D/H ratio of $\sim$16% per H atom.

This points to a common formation mechanism of these species including efficient H-D substitution reactions on grain-surfaces at low temperatures with these being more efficient one the first deuteration has occurred

why_this_data.value: The degree of deuteration and line intensities of c-C2H3DO in PILS were high enough to make detecting doubly deuterated oxirane plausible; the one-beam offset position from Source B has narrow lines (~1 km s^-1) and limited continuum opacity.

evidence.quote: The degree of deuteration in $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO and its line intensities were sufficiently high in the PILS data that it appeared plausible to detect doubly deuterated oxirane as well (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023).
This position is ideal because of the narrow lines seen there ($\sim$1 km s$^{-1}$), which allows for searches for rare species and limited continuum opacity causing absorption to be less severe.

why_this_method.value: Optically thin LTE synthetic spectra are valid because of the high densities in the molecular cloud surrounding the protostar probed by the ALMA observations.

evidence.quote: The synthetic spectra are calculated under the assumption of the emission being optically thin and the excitation being in local thermodynamical equilibrium. This is a valid assumption given the high densities in the molecular cloud surrounding the protostar

how_they_decided_enough.value: In the laboratory spectrum, 1289 transition frequencies up to J=58 determined a full eighth-order parameter set accurate enough for all radio astronomical observations; in ALMA data, only a handful of lines matched, so the detection was deemed tentative.

evidence.quote: The $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O parameter set in the S reduction and the III$^l$ representation is very similar in extent and absolute uncertainties to those of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023) and $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: c-C2H4O_rot_2022). Therefore, the data should be sufficiently accurate for all radio astronomical observations.
Still, our astronomical results on $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O should be viewed with some caution as the number of identified lines is on the low side to claim a definitive detection.

limitations_admitted.value: The astronomical detection of c-CD2CH2O is only tentative because the number of identified lines is on the low side, and several predicted lines fall below the RMS noise or are blended.

evidence.quote: For some of these predicted lines, no clear signal is seen down to the RMS noise level of the data (1$\sigma$ being 4$-$5 mJy beam$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$)
Still, our astronomical results on $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O should be viewed with some caution as the number of identified lines is on the low side to claim a definitive detection.

limitations_admitted.value: Very weak laboratory lines and some intended high-Kc transitions around 1 THz were affected by line blending with other isotopologs, excited vibrational states, or neighboring lines.

evidence.loc: Analysis of the c-CD2CH2O rotational spectrum and determination of spectroscopic parameters
evidence.quote: line blending with other isotopic species or with excited vibrational states appeared to be only slightly more important than in our investigation of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023) for the most part, except probably for the very weak lines

evidence.loc: Analysis of the c-CD2CH2O rotational spectrum and determination of spectroscopic parameters
evidence.quote: Many of the intended high $K_c$ transitions were too weak, heavily blended, or too close to neighboring lines such that only few of them were added to the line list.

referee_caveats_inferred: The column density of c-CD2CH2O is derived with T_rot, FWHM, and v_LSR held fixed to values from c-C2H4O without a formal uncertainty estimate given for N(c-CD2CH2O).

Line confusion in the line-rich spectrum of IRAS 16293-2422 B makes tentative assignments based on a few weak features (~20-32 mJy km s^-1) susceptible to false positives from uncatalogued lines of other COMs.
